# Netdryrun

> Netdryrun is an open-source tool (Python, Apache-2.0) that tests network changes in a real containerlab virtual lab before they reach production. It waits for convergence, checks BGP sessions, prefixes, routes and reachability, and returns a pass/fail verdict with evidence. Supported network OSes: FRR, Nokia SR Linux, SONiC, Arista EOS (cEOS). It runs locally, in GitHub Actions, or as an MCP server for AI agents.

Install: `pip install netdryrun` (version 0.2.0). Source: https://github.com/netdryrun/netdryrun

## Docs

- [GitHub Action](https://netdryrun.com/github-action/): inputs, outputs, security notes
- [AI agents (MCP)](https://netdryrun.com/ai-agents/): MCP server tools and safety model
